display.purpose: Hero headings only, set with hard line breaks across three short lines. At most twice per screen.

headline.purpose: Secondary serif moments — the open search input, mobile menu links. Makes an interface element feel spoken.

title.purpose: Navigation links, mega-menu links, card titles. Anything clickable and short.

body.purpose: Page and product copy. Not yet implemented; 16px minimum, line-height 1.6, 65–75ch measure when it lands.

label.purpose: Uppercase button labels and the announcement bar. Always tracked on the ladder: 15px/0.12em, 14px/0.11em, 12px/0.08em.

shadows.name: panel-drop
shadows.purpose: Separation for a panel overlaying the page — the open mega menu only. Reads as separation, not height.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus state of an interactive card, paired with a 3px upward translate. Never at rest.

shadows.name: hero-text
shadows.purpose: Legibility insurance for display type over hero photography. Not decorative; not for use off the hero.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Icon hover disc, skip link, focus hand-off into the search field.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Search panel, mobile menu, mega menu open/close; button colour and lift.

motion.name: duration-line
motion.purpose: Nav underline wipe and card lift.

motion.name: duration-image
motion.purpose: Card image scale to 1.04 on hover. The only duration above 220ms in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing curve used. Nothing in this system overshoots or bounces.

motion.name: mega-close-delay
motion.purpose: Grace period before the mega menu closes on mouse-out, so a diagonal cursor path does not dismiss it.

motion.name: testimonial-arrive
motion.purpose: A changed customer review settles into place from 10px below. Removed entirely when reduced motion is preferred.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's only button on pale grounds — translucent ivory with a hairline brown outline, inverting to solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 252px; min-height: 58px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); color: var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); background: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.86); font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color: #fffaf3; background: var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Button on Dark
components.description: The hero variant: same geometry, Lamplight stroke and label, a whisper of backdrop blur over photography.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { min-width: 252px; min-height: 58px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(247, 237, 225, 0.75); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); color: #f7ede1; background: rgba(23, 19, 16, 0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover, .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { color: #23150f; background: #f7ede1; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header link with the signature underline that wipes in from the right and out to the left.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: block; padding: 8px 0; color: #2d150f; font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 2px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 42px stroked-icon action with a circular 8%-brown disc that scales up behind it on hover. The only circle in the system.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.75"></circle><path d="M15.4 15.4 20.5 20.5"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { position: relative; width: 42px; height: 42px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; color: #17100e; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-icon-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(74, 38, 28, 0.08); opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.72); transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover::before, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

components.name: Category Card
components.description: Pastry Cream tile with a 4/3 clipped image and an outline arrow. Two speeds on hover: the card rises, the image scales.
components.html: Chutneys & Relishes
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); background: var(--cream, #eee4d6); color: #2d150f; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 16px 26px -20px rgba(45, 21, 15, 0.6); } .ds-card__media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 400ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__media img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-card__foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 18px 18px; } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card__arrow svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: block; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.4; transition: transform 220ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__arrow svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Customer Review Carousel
components.description: Image-led customer proof with one review visible at a time. There is no autoplay; arrows wrap, the focused viewport accepts Left/Right Arrow, and one atomic polite status announces each complete change. At 900px the photograph stacks before the review field.

outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-review figure, .ds-review blockquote { margin: 0; } .ds-review blockquote p { max-width: 24ch; margin: 0; font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 50px); gap: 12px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 40px; } .ds-review__foot button { width: 52px; height: 52px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); background: var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-review__foot button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-review__foot svg { width: 24px; components.name: Search Field
components.description: No box — a Caslon-set line on a single hairline rule, with a borderless uppercase submit. Reads as writing, not a form control.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); } .ds-search__input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 4px; border: 0; color: #2d150f; background: transparent; font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 25px; } .ds-search__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--chocolate-deep, #32150f); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-search__submit { padding: 8px 4px 8px 24px; border: 0; color: #2d150f; background: transparent; font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Announcement Bar
components.description: 34px Fig Chutney Brown band at the top of every page. Height is structural — it truncates rather than wraps.
components.css: .ds-announcement { height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0 24px; color: #fffdf8; background: var(--chocolate, #4a261c); } .ds-announcement p { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Link
components.description: Below 860px the nav becomes a Fig Chutney Brown panel with Caslon-set links divided by 20%-white hairlines.
components.css: .ds-mobile-menu { display: grid; gap: 0; margin: 0; padding: 22px 28px; list-style: none; color: var(--ivory, #f8f4ec); background: var(--chocolate, #4a261c); } .ds-mobile-menu li + li { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); } .ds-mobile-menu a { display: block; padding: 13px 0; color: inherit; font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 26px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mobile-menu a:hover, .ds-mobile-menu a:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a table set in daylight: linen, ripe fruit, glass jars, people about to eat. The world is warm, pale and generous, built on an ivory ground with fig-brown ink. Nothing here is clinical and nothing is precious. The brand has made the same recipes in the same kitchen since 1988, and the design should feel like that — settled, unhurried, sure of itself.

The one deliberate exception is the doorway. Every page opens on a dark, full-bleed photographic hero — evening light, dark stone, the table after sundown — and then the site turns to daylight from the fold down. The dark is an entrance, not the house. It buys one moment of atmosphere and then gets out of the way so the shopping surfaces can be bright, legible and calm.

The execution is crisp editorial, not rustic. Corners are nearly square (2px), borders are hairlines, shadows are almost absent, and typography does the work: a high-contrast Caslon display against a plain, tightly-set grotesque. Warmth comes entirely from the palette and the photography, never from soft corners, drop shadows or decorative flourish. The result should read as a serious food brand that happens to be family-run, not a craft-market stall.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory ground, fig-brown ink, one dark photographic hero per page
Libre Caslon Display for voice, DM Sans for everything operational
Near-square corners (2px / 4px); circles reserved for icon states only
Flat at rest — shadow only ever appears as a response to hover or focus
Uppercase, wide-tracked labels as the only ornament
Motion is short (180–220ms) and ease-only; nothing bounces

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: There is no second accent hue. Every colour in this system is the same warm brown at a different lightness, plus the ivory it sits on. If a screen needs emphasis, it changes tone or weight — it does not introduce a colour.

rules.name: The Doorway Rule
rules.body: Night Stone appears once per page, in the hero, and never below it. A second dark section on the same page is off-system unless the user has explicitly asked for one.

rules.name: The Dietary Contrast Rule
rules.body: Dietary and ingredient text is safety information. It is set in Chutney Ink on Linen Ivory or Pastry Cream — never on photography, never on Night Stone, never in a translucent panel.

rules.name: The Rare Serif Rule
rules.body: Libre Caslon Display appears at most twice per screen. It is the brand's voice, and a voice that speaks constantly stops being heard.

rules.name: The Tracking Ladder Rule
rules.body: Uppercase text is always tracked, and the smaller it is the wider it tracks: 15px → 0.12em, 14px → 0.11em, 12px → 0.08em. Uppercase at default tracking is off-system.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a shadow in its default state. If a card needs to look separate while idle, change its tone to Pastry Cream — do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Single Review Rule
rules.body: Customer proof arrives as one generous table-side story at a time, never a wall of review cards. Keep review, customer and purchased-product data as explicit placeholders until verified; do not infer identities or add stars, scores, totals, awards or badges.

dos: Do keep every screen grounded in Linen Ivory (#f8f4ec) with Chutney Ink (#2d150f) text.
Do obey the three-radius scale exactly: 2px for controls, 4px for surfaces, 999px only for circles.
Do set dietary, allergen and ingredient text in solid ink on a solid pale surface, at body size or larger.
Do track uppercase text on the ladder — 15px/0.12em, 14px/0.11em, 12px/0.08em.
Do keep transitions between 180ms and 220ms with plain ease; 400ms is reserved for image scale.
Do pair :hover with :focus-visible on every interactive element, as the current stylesheet already does throughout.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion — the stylesheet already collapses all transitions to 0.01ms.
Do keep testimonial review, customer and product data explicitly marked as placeholders until the client supplies verified copy.
Do use the fluid gutter clamp(28px, 3.2vw, 64px) for horizontal page padding.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. Emphasis is tone and weight, never colour.
Don't put a resting shadow on any surface.
Don't use Night Stone below the hero, or run a second dark band on the same page.
Don't set Libre Caslon Display more than twice per screen, and never for body copy.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons, chips or inputs — the pill radius is for circles only.
Don't grow the announcement bar past 34px (30px mobile); truncate instead of wrapping.
Don't let the mega menu and the search panel be open at once; opening either closes the other.

Don't invent star ratings, scores, review totals, review copy, customer identities, purchased-product attributions, badges or award marks — there is no visual vocabulary for them because there is no evidence for them.
